author: Muse (port)
notmario (original mod)
description: 89 Jokers ported from MoreFluff by notmario, including the Letter Jokers, the Scrapped (oldfluff) set and token Jokers. Requires the Balatro3DS fork build (github.com/sen2008/balatro3ds-fork): the port uses the fork's SMODS.Rarity registrations, SMODS.add_card / destroy_card, retrigger and post_trigger passes, and probability-shaping contexts, none of which exist on the stock game. Six MoreFluff rarities are registered at weight 0, as on PC they arrive via other Jokers and effects rather than the shop. The remaining 140 PC Jokers are blocked on systems the fork does not have (Slivers, Colour cards, prepared cards, exile, custom enhancements and more); the pack README lists each one with its blocker.
name: MoreFluff Pack
